records.summary: Drive-end bearing replaced (6309-2RS); coupling removed and re-fitted. Alignment not re-verified after reassembly.
Routine inspection. Vibration within limits, no action taken.

indicators: recent coupling or bearing work without alignment verification
failure_modes.repair_instruction: Stop the pump, laser-align motor and pump shafts, verify coupling torque, re-check vibration spectrum at 1x/2x running speed.

indicators: bearing temperature rising at constant load
failure_modes.repair_instruction: Replace the affected bearing and inspect lubrication schedule.
